name: Kisaragi Nana
source:
A magical girl.

Nana comes from an ordinary family. After graduating from high school, she couldn’t pick a career. With her boyfriend at the time, [url=/c102840]Satoru[/url], pestering her for money, she joined the Special Warfare Troopers since she was told the pay was good.

She has a kind personality, but gets carried away easily. However, on the flip side, she's also amicable and highly adaptable.

[From [url=https://deadendaegis.com/#4]official website[/url]]
